summary: Phase 2 verification system tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_verification_phase2.py — covering mock provider outcomes (auto-approve / human_review / reject on FAIL prefix), submit rules, verified-only gate integrity (401/403/200), admin queue rendering with member-entered prescreen fields, admin approve/reject decisions with alerts, append-only log sequence (Application submitted -> ID.me inconclusive -> Routed to manual review -> Agency confirmation approved [reviewer=admin email] -> Account activation), data boundary (verification_records contain only id/user_id/current_state/provider/provider_reference/outcome/timestamps/prescreen — no raw docs, no access_token, no userinfo), and provider swap via VERIFICATION_PROVIDER=sheerid at code level (get_provider returns SheerIDProvider without code changes). Frontend Playwright: registered fresh member -> landed on /verification with 4-step form (data-testid verification-form) -> submitted REVIEW-1 -> status label became 'In human review' -> verification-log populated with 4 events. Admin logged in, /admin rendered admin-review-queue with the pending case, member-entered fields (agency, rank, years, credential #) fully visible in card, approve button removed the case from queue after decision. SMS mock confirmed in backend logs (Twilio unconfigured -> [SMS mock] line). Email alerts return 4xx from Resend for @example.com test recipients (rate limited / undeliverable_recipient) — this is Resend deliverability protection for test domains, not a code defect; transitions still succeed because notify() catches exceptions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~950 lines — consider splitting auth / verification / admin into modules if it grows further.
verification_config could arguably be public (no PII); currently requires auth which is safe/fine.
notify() swallows email exceptions (good — transitions must not fail) and logs them; consider surfacing a delivery_failed audit row for observability.
test_credentials: admin@firstunit.us / FirstUnit#Admin2026! ; members registered ephemerally with credential values BADGE* (pass), REVIEW-* (human review), FAIL-* (reject).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test_p2_<uuid>@example.com members created and left in DB (inert).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 fully green. Mock provider path is exercised via POST /api/verification/submit; OAuth callback is NOT tested (mock mode). To test real ID.me OAuth in a future run, populate IDME_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REDIRECT_URI and drive /api/verification/idme/callback. Provider swap validated at code level via importlib.reload; a service restart would be required if you flip the env var in production.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. Email 4xx during test runs is Resend's undeliverable_recipient / rate limit protection against test domains, not a code bug.
